## The IQ gap between men and women, simulated

Take the claim as it is usually stated: two groups, a mean difference of a few
points, the same spread either side. Then draw from it, because nearly every
question people actually argue about is arithmetic on that draw — how far the
two distributions overlap, what share of the top and bottom percentiles comes
from each group, and how often a randomly chosen pair reverses the group
verdict. The answers move very little from sample to sample, which is the whole
point: a claim about distributions is settled by drawing from them, not by
citing the most extreme person anyone has happened to meet.
